decisive_items: recurrent episodes of abdominal pain, bloating, and obstipation, alternating with intermittent diarrhea
exploratory laparotomy “showed no mechanical cause of the obstructions”
CT scan showed small-bowel dilation (approximately 23 mm in diameter) consistent with obstruction
response.rationale: Chronic pseudo-obstruction best explains recurrent obstructive symptoms, dilated small bowel and megacolon, with no mechanical obstruction found at laparotomy. Short bowel syndrome is unsupported because there is no history of bowel resection.

rejected.why: No bowel resection is described; weight loss and fat-soluble vitamin deficiencies are nonspecific malabsorptive consequences better explained by pseudo-obstruction and associated bacterial overgrowth.
